summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, furnishing its Hong Kong Annual Report for fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 and its Environmental, Social and Governance Report for the same period. This is a routine regulatory filing requirement for a foreign private issuer listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, not a special situation. No transaction or extraordinary corporate event is described. The filing serves purely to satisfy reporting obligations under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Exchange Act.
